author: Huawei
description:
Ever wondered how AI knows whether "bank" refers to a financial institution or a riverbank? 🧠👀

While embeddings give words coordinates, attention gives them context.

In Episode 4 of Understanding LLMs from Scratch, we break down the famous "Attention" mechanism—the heart of the Transformer revolution. Discover the simple 3-step calculation behind attention (Scoring, Normalization, and Weighted Summation), how Query, Key, and Value vectors work together, why Multi-Head Attention views sentences from multiple perspectives, and how Causal Masking ensures AI generates text one token at a time.

No technical background needed! Join us as we demystify how LLMs connect words and understand context, one step at a time.

▶️ Watch Episode 4 and discover why attention is all you need.

#UnderstandingLLMs #Huawei #AI #LargeLanguageModels #LLMExplained
title: How the Attention Mechanism Gives AI Context | LLMs Explained, Ep. 4

author: Huawei
description:
How does AI know that "Paris" and "France" are related, or tell the difference between a riverbank and a financial bank?🧠📍

While tokens give LLMs text to read, embeddings give those words meaning.

In Episode 3 of Understanding LLMs from Scratch, we dive into how large language models map tokens into a multidimensional vector space to represent semantic relationships.

Learn how AI uses vector arithmetic to connect concepts like king, man, and woman, how Transformers adjust word meanings based on context, and how positional encoding helps models track word order.

No technical background needed! Join us as we demystify the full input pipeline behind generative AI, vector by vector.

▶️ Watch Episode 3 and discover how AI connects the dots between words.

#Huawei #AI #LargeLanguageModels #LLMExplained #UnderstandingLLMs
title: How AI Gives Words Meaning with Embeddings | LLMs Explained, Ep. 3

author: Huawei
description:
Ever wondered how AI reads and understands the words you type? 🤖

It all starts with tokens, the building blocks of large language models (LLMs).

In Episode 2 of Understanding LLMs from Scratch, we explore how AI breaks text into tokens and why tokenization matters. From the differences between English and Chinese to the surprising ways AI interprets everyday words, discover how tokens influence the way LLMs process language, manage context, and calculate costs.

No technical background needed! Join us as we uncover another fundamental concept behind generative AI, one token at a time.

▶️ Watch Episode 2 and discover why every token counts.

#Huawei #AI #LargeLanguageModels #LLMExplained #UnderstandingLLMs
title: What Are Tokens in Large Language Models? | LLMs Explained, Ep. 2

description:
Ever wondered how AI can answer questions, write stories, or hold a conversation? 🤖

The secret starts with something surprisingly simple: predicting the next token.

In Episode 1 of Understanding LLMs from Scratch, we break down how large language models (LLMs) generate text, one token at a time. From familiar smartphone keyboards to powerful AI models, discover how next-token prediction helps explain the technology behind generative AI.

No technical background needed! Join us as we explore the fundamentals of LLMs, one concept at a time.

▶️ Watch Episode 1 and discover how it all begins.
